commit.subject: tests: move dispatch launch modules onto testkit
commit.body:
Move test_launch_record.py, test_launch_snapshot.py, and test_launch_harness_fixes.py onto ops.testkit while preserving all 56 test names and assertions.

World owns temporary roots and environments, fixture plants use World, and every local subprocess routes through run with an explicit timeout. Each module was proven red before its final green run; the complete 622-test dispatch family is green. One producer; second producer absent.

Source: original
Co-Authored-By: GPT-5 Codex <noreply@openai.com>
